_comment: Scenes for tools/check/picture_check.py: each is captured at `seconds` of game time from a fresh save, with `env` driving the game there (PUNCHOUT_INPUT presses, PUNCHOUT_POINTER moves; see docs/runtime.md). `max_over8` is the largest share of pixels (percent) allowed to be more than 8 of 255 off Dolphin's render of the same frame in any channel, and `max_over48` the largest share more than 48 off. Scenes marked slow are skipped unless --slow is given; scenes marked needs_save start from a copy of --save's saves (a profile), and are skipped without it. The scripts here are for a save with one profile (a default Mii).
